rubric: This is a tech video transcript (reviews, explainers, tech news, commentary). A great clip is ONE point with its proof: a verdict with the reason ("this is the best ... because"), a surprising test result or number, a hidden feature, a strong comparison, or a hot take on a company or product. It opens on the claim or the question, never on a spec list or "so next", and ends once the verdict or result is said. Reject sponsor reads, unboxing filler, spec lists with no verdict, and channel housekeeping.
outline: A topic is one product, one feature, one test or one argument. A new topic starts at the next feature, the next test, the next product or the next news item. Sponsor segments, intros and outros belong to no topic.
review: A tech clip must state its point and reach its verdict or result: never end on the set-up of the next feature, a spec list, or the move to the sponsor.
